title: Frump's Favor
html:
Quest Giver: Junior Exec Ivan

Quest Type: Deliver

Quest Description: Find "Opportunity" in an Ancient Relic Chest in Frump's Misfortune.

Quest Reward: 5 KC

Return to: Junior Exec Ivan

Repeatable: Yes

In-game text

Journal text, offer, and turn-in as they appeared in game.

Journal: Collect 'Opportunity' from within Frump's Misfortune and Return to Junior Exev Ivan.

Offer:

I have something you can do to get on The Frump's good side, if you fancy yourself a treasure hunter. The Frump is always looking to buy rare relics and there is one that can be found within Frump's Misfortune that The Frump is partial to. Some say that this relic has some magical properties that The Frump has used in the past to get ahead of the competition, but who cares about magical properties in the face of cold hard King's Coin.

Rummage around in Frump's Misfortune until you find an Ancient Relic Chest and that is where you find The Frump's Favorite Relic. When you have the relic return to me, Junior Exec Ivan, here in Frump's Interdungeonal Resort.

Turn-in:

You found it? You must be one lucky Dungeon Runner. I bet you get all the good drops. Let me know if you want to hunt this treasure again.

Objectives:

  • 'Opportunity' ×1

Level range: 25–35
